content: Compose charts: List/Map/Set params are unstable -> chart recomposes whenever parent does; use immutable wrappers/kotlinx-immutable or stable data holders; heavy per-frame allocation in DrawScope (Path rebuilds) causes jank; drawWithCache caches Path/Brush across draws; graphicsLayer lambda / lambda-based offsets keep scrub interactions in draw phase only; defer state reads so tooltip scrub doesn't recompose whole chart.
